$comment: Single source of truth for the Web <-> Android Trusted Web Activity bridge contract (issue #884). Read by src/lib/native/bridge-contract.ts (web), android/app/src/test/.../BridgeContractTest.kt (Android unit tests) and android/app/build.gradle.kts (BuildConfig.NATIVE_BRIDGE_VERSION). A change here is a contract change: bump bridgeVersion only with a new command or a changed shape, never to rename, and see docs/android-runtime.md#bridge-contract before editing.
transport: CustomTabsSession.requestPostMessageChannel inside a Trusted Web Activity (Chrome 115+). The page receives a MessagePort from the app; every frame is a JSON envelope. Requires delegate_permission/common.use_as_origin in public/.well-known/assetlinks.json.
